text:
Allison (CTO): Quick follow-up from today's runtime roadmap segment. Capture remaining Qs and action items here.

Ana V: When you say adaptive batching, is that per-model or global? Worried about noisy neighbors.

Devon (runtime): Adaptive is per-route + per-model profile. Router tags traffic so runtime keeps separate batching buckets. No global stealing.

Shreya K: Will Console surface those route tags and recommend policies?

Devon (runtime): Yes 12 Console will show assigned profile, observed batch sizes, suggested policy. API to patch route policy planned.

Liam - Eng: Timeline for fused attention on AMD? Infra needs capacity planning.

Devon (runtime): NVIDIA fused kernels first. AMD MI family next quarter for beta, dependent on bench results and partner tests.

Ana V: Prefix/KV cache isolation12tenant-scoped or shared? Enterprise flagged cross-tenant residency.

Devon (runtime): Default tenant-scoped for Hosted. Dedicated/Private can opt for node-local isolated caches. Will add config flags and docs on TTL/eviction.

Shreya K: Observability: can we get sampled traces linking request->batch->kernel id + timings? Useful for regressions.

Devon (runtime): Plan: sampled JSON traces with trace_id, batch_size, kernel_id, seq_len, model_variant. Exposed in Console and response header when sampled.

Allison (CTO): Governance: any change to default batching/window requires canary plan + rollback playbook in PR.

ops-bot: Canary deploy window 01:00-05:00 UTC. :calendar:

deploy-bot: Canary started: service=runtime, sha=ab3d9c1

Liam - Eng: Paste CLI example to flip route to throughput mode for integration tests?

Devon (runtime): Example: `rwctl route update --name payments-infer --policy throughput --batch-window=30ms --slo=200ms`

Ana V: Document fallback order if kernel missing under load?

Devon (runtime): Fallback: 1) compatible quantized variant, 2) smaller seq_len profile, 3) route to fallback pool (higher latency), 4) 503 with retry-after if none. Will codify in fallback doc.

Shreya K: Add Console warning when route frequently in fallback. Ops needs early signal.

Devon (runtime): Will emit metric route_fallback_rate and add warning card in Console.

Allison (CTO): Action items: Devon - add canary+rollback checklist to batching PRs; Shreya - draft Console route policy copy; Liam - validate sampled traces and share perf numbers. I'll review fallback doc.

Ana V: :thumbsup:

Liam - Eng: Will post perf summary here by EOD.

Devon (runtime): Following up with PR links and Console mockups soon.
